name: Saneyama Asuhi
source:
Hinare's partner in crime and white gal-like heroine. She uses "uchi" to address herself.

She may look cool, neat, and proper, but in reality, she is a slut just like Hinare. Although she and Hinare have opposite looks, their personalities seem to be quite compatible and they often hang out together.

Her tone of voice is cool and polite at times, but she also has a tendency to make crude remarks. She is very popular with the girls and female teachers at school. There's more than meets the eye regarding her popularity with girls.

Although she comes from an upper class family, she does not get along well with her family and feels uncomfortable at home.

[From [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/105gyaru/#character]official site[/url]]
